full_text: The screenshot shows the L.A. Care Provider Portal webpage. The page includes options for providers to log in, verify patient eligibility, view claims, and download forms. A contact section lists L.A. Care Health Plan at 1055 W. 7th Street, 10th Floor, Los Angeles, CA 90017, with an eligibility self-service phone number of 1-844-901-7272. Developer tools are open at the bottom of the screen, highlighting the HTML code for the contact information block.
